metadata.description: Stable compiler error registry with namespaced placeholder ranges (Sprint 2C).

namespaces.name: Validation
namespaces.description: Schema, policy, and content validation errors.

namespaces.name: Dependency
namespaces.description: Cross-record and cross-module dependency resolution errors.

namespaces.name: Reference / Citation
namespaces.description: Academic Source and Foundation reference citation errors.
namespaces.notes: WARNING: code prefix REF- overlaps Foundation Reference IDs; treat as error-namespace codes in compiler context only.

namespaces.name: Schema
namespaces.description: JSON Schema conformance and overlay errors.

notes: Ranges VAL-000001..VAL-000100 (and peers) are reserved placeholder capacity.
Only explicitly listed entries in errors[] are defined codes.
Unused codes in each range remain unallocated placeholders.

errors.title: Validation Failed
errors.description: A validation gate failed for the target artifact or record.
errors.recommended_action: Inspect validation_report details, fix the failing rule, and re-run STAGE-VALIDATE.

errors.title: Validation Policy Violation
errors.description: An enabled citation or compile policy rule was violated.
errors.recommended_action: Compare findings against citation_rules.json / compiler policy and correct the record design inputs.

errors.title: Validation Warning Threshold Exceeded
errors.description: Warning count exceeded the configured threshold for Official promotion.
errors.recommended_action: Resolve warnings or obtain Governance exception before STAGE-PUBLISH.

errors.title: Integrity Check Failed
errors.description: Post-checks detected integrity inconsistency (duplicate IDs, broken invariants).
errors.recommended_action: Review verify_report integrity section and remediate duplicate or inconsistent identifiers.

errors.title: Placeholder Content Not Allowed For Official
errors.description: Official publish attempted while placeholder/TODO_REVIEW markers remain disallowed by policy.
errors.recommended_action: Complete Academic Review fields or keep status as draft until placeholders are cleared.

errors.title: Parse Failure
errors.description: Input could not be parsed into normalized intermediate representation.
errors.recommended_action: Fix malformed input at the reported path and re-run STAGE-PARSE.

errors.title: Unsupported Input Format
errors.description: Loaded input format is not supported by the current compiler version.
errors.recommended_action: Convert input to a supported pack/format version listed in version_registry.json.

errors.title: Unresolved Dependency
errors.description: A required planning ID or knowledge ID dependency could not be resolved.
errors.recommended_action: Add the missing dependency target or remove the invalid relationship link.

errors.title: Dependency Cycle Detected
errors.description: A cyclic dependency was detected among records or modules.
errors.recommended_action: Break the cycle or provide Academic justification and Governance approval for allowed cycles.

errors.title: Unknown Academic Source
errors.description: Cited SRC-* is not present in bibliography.json.
errors.recommended_action: Register the source via bibliography governance or remove the invalid citation.

errors.title: Placeholder Source Used
errors.description: Citation references a bibliography source with status placeholder.
errors.recommended_action: Allow for draft compiles; block Official until source metadata is promoted.

errors.title: Foundation Reference Crosswalk Unverified
errors.description: SRC↔REF crosswalk exists but is not marked verified for Official use.
errors.recommended_action: Complete Academic verification of crosswalk or omit Foundation expansion in Official docs.

errors.title: Schema Validation Failed
errors.description: JSON does not validate against the required Knowledge Record or overlay schema.
errors.recommended_action: Fix schema violations listed in validation_report and re-validate.

errors.title: Schema Version Incompatible
errors.description: Record schema_version is incompatible with compiler compatibility set.
errors.recommended_action: Align metadata.schema_version with version_registry.json COMPAT set.

errors.title: Transform Mapping Incomplete
errors.description: Required design-to-JSON mapping field is missing or incomplete.
errors.recommended_action: Complete RECORD_MAPPING_TEMPLATE for the failing field and re-run STAGE-TRANSFORM.

errors.title: Generate Output Failed
errors.description: Failed to generate a required compile artifact.
errors.recommended_action: Inspect stage logs for the artifact id and retry STAGE-GENERATE after fixing inputs.

errors.title: Graph Generation Disabled
errors.description: knowledge_graph artifact skipped because graph_generation is false.
errors.recommended_action: Enable compiler_config.graph_generation if graph output is required.

errors.title: Search Index Generation Disabled
errors.description: search_index artifact skipped because search_index_generation is false.
errors.recommended_action: Enable compiler_config.search_index_generation if search output is required.

errors.title: Publish Unauthorized
errors.description: STAGE-PUBLISH blocked because publish_authorization is missing or invalid.
errors.recommended_action: Obtain Governance authorization artifact before publishing Official records.

errors.title: Publish Blocked By Verify Report
errors.description: Verify stage reported blocking errors; publish cannot proceed.
errors.recommended_action: Clear STAGE-VERIFY errors and re-run verify before publish.

errors.title: Load Input Missing
errors.description: A required input artifact was missing during STAGE-LOAD.
errors.recommended_action: Provide the missing artifact path/id listed in load_manifest errors.

errors.title: Compiler Config Invalid
errors.description: compiler_config.json failed schema or compatibility checks.
errors.recommended_action: Fix compiler_config.json against compiler.schema.json and version_registry compatibility.

errors.title: Internal Compiler Registry Inconsistency
errors.description: Compiler control-plane registries are inconsistent (pipeline vs artifact/error registries).
errors.recommended_action: Repair registry metadata under knowledge/compiler/ before running compile.
